articles.title: Hackers Distribute Malicious Claude Code Extension on Cursor Marketplace to Install Persistent SSH Backdoor
articles.summary:
Microsoft has warned that malicious Claude Code extensions distributed through Cursor’s marketplace attempted to install a persistent SSH backdoor on developer workstations. The trojanized packages, anthropic.claude-code versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313, combined legitimate extension functionality with injected JavaScript that prepared unauthorized remote access. articles.title: Hackers Exploit PHP2Shell RCE Vulnerabilities to Gain Root Access on Palo Alto Firewalls
articles.summary:
